mapper.insert: insert into bbs_idea_proposal( title, category, content, background_text, plan_text, expected_value, visibility_scope, attachment_urls, related_case, team_name, is_draft, review_stage, review_deadline, biz_value, status, submit_user_id, submit_nick_name, create_time, update_time ) values( #{title}, #{category}, #{content}, #{backgroundText}, #{planText}, #{expectedValue}, #{visibilityScope}, #{attachmentUrls}, #{relatedCase}, #{teamName}, #{isDraft}, #{reviewStage}, #{reviewDeadline}, #{bizValue}, #{status}, #{submitUserId}, #{submitNickName}, now(), now() )
mapper.select:
select i.idea_id, i.title, i.category, i.content, i.background_text, i.plan_text, i.expected_value, i.visibility_scope, i.attachment_urls, i.related_case, i.team_name, i.is_draft, i.review_stage, i.reject_reason, i.project_time, i.landing_time, i.is_publicized, i.incentive_points, i.honor_badge, i.like_count, i.share_count, i.review_deadline, i.biz_value, i.status, i.avg_score, i.result_summary, i.submit_user_id, i.submit_nick_name, i.create_time, i.update_time from bbs_idea_proposal i
i.del_flag = '0' and i.is_publicized = '1' and i.category = #{category}
and (i.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or i.result_summary like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by i.like_count desc, i.landing_time desc order by i.incentive_points desc, i.like_count desc order by i.landing_time desc, i.create_time desc
select count(1) from bbs_idea_proposal where submit_user_id = #{submitUserId} and is_draft = '0' and del_flag = '0' and date(create_time) = curdate()

select i.idea_id, i.title, i.category, i.content, i.background_text, i.plan_text, i.expected_value, i.visibility_scope, i.attachment_urls, i.related_case, i.team_name, i.is_draft, i.review_stage, i.reject_reason, i.project_time, i.landing_time, i.is_publicized, i.incentive_points, i.honor_badge, i.like_count, i.share_count, i.review_deadline, i.biz_value, i.status, i.avg_score, i.result_summary, i.submit_user_id, i.submit_nick_name, i.create_time, i.update_time from bbs_idea_proposal i where i.idea_id = #{ideaId} and i.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_idea_review( idea_id, stage, action, reviewer_user_id, reviewer_nick_name, score, comment, reject_reason, is_visible_to_all, review_time, create_time ) values( #{ideaId}, #{stage}, #{action}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{reviewerNickName}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{rejectReason}, #{isVisibleToAll}, #{reviewTime}, now() )
mapper.select: select review_id, idea_id, stage, action, reviewer_user_id, reviewer_nick_name, score, comment, reject_reason, is_visible_to_all, review_time, create_time from bbs_idea_review where idea_id = #{ideaId} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_idea_progress( idea_id, status_enum, updater_user_id, updater_nick_name, progress_stage, progress_desc, attachment_urls, progress_percent, create_time ) values( #{ideaId}, #{statusEnum}, #{updaterUserId}, #{updaterNickName}, #{progressStage}, #{progressDesc}, #{attachmentUrls}, #{progressPercent}, now() )
mapper.select: select max(progress_percent) from bbs_idea_progress where idea_id = #{ideaId}

select progress_id, idea_id, status_enum, updater_user_id, updater_nick_name, progress_stage, progress_desc, attachment_urls, progress_percent, create_time from bbs_idea_progress where idea_id = #{ideaId} order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update bbs_idea_proposal set review_stage = #{reviewStage}, review_deadline = #{reviewDeadline}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where idea_id = #{ideaId}

update bbs_idea_proposal set status = 'PUBLICIZED', is_publicized = '1', result_summary = #{resultSummary}, incentive_points = #{incentivePoints}, honor_badge = #{honorBadge}, update_time = now() where idea_id = #{ideaId}
mapper.select: select r1.review_id, r1.idea_id, r1.stage, r1.action, r1.reviewer_user_id, r1.reviewer_nick_name, r1.score, r1.comment, r1.reject_reason, r1.is_visible_to_all, r1.review_time, r1.create_time from bbs_idea_review r1 where r1.idea_id = #{ideaId} and r1.stage = #{stage} and r1.create_time = ( select max(r2.create_time) from bbs_idea_review r2 where r2.idea_id = r1.idea_id and r2.stage = r1.stage and r2.reviewer_user_id = r1.reviewer_user_id )
